description: This is a Java implementation of the ShoppingCartService, specifically ShoppingCartServiceImpl, which handles shopping cart operations such as retrieval, merging, validation, and persistence in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: ShoppingCartServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class of ShoppingCartService that provides methods to manage shopping carts in an e-commerce platform, including retrieval, updating, merging, and validation.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart for a specific customer and populates its contents.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new shopping cart or updates an existing one.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a shopping cart by its ID, with optional store context, and populates its contents.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart using a code identifier and populates it.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Gets a shopping cart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: populateShoppingCart
methods.description: Populates a shopping cart's items, recalculates prices, and removes obsolete items.

methods.name: populateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Creates a ShoppingCartItem from a product, calculating its price.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Creates a list of ShippingProduct objects based on shopping cart items that require shipping.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Determines if a shopping cart has only free products.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Checks if the shopping cart contains products that require shipping.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes a shopping cart from the database.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merges two shopping carts into one, combining items and quantities.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Creates ShoppingCartItems from existing shopping cart items, with attribute matching and price calculation.
